title: Fix Mark Past Attendance calendar header layout/spacing

requirements.text: Fix the calendar header layout in the "Mark Past Attendance" modal so it has three clearly separated sections (Header navigation row, Weekday row, Date grid) with no overlap/collision, and the month title remains perfectly centered between left/right navigation arrows on all screen sizes.

quotes: Fix the UI bug in the calendar component inside the "Mark Past Attendance" modal.
The calendar must have 3 clearly separated sections: Header Section (Navigation Row), Weekday Row (Below Header), Date Grid Section
Month title must be perfectly centered
Use Flexbox Layout for Header: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding-left: 16px; padding-right: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px

acceptanceCriteria: In the past attendance date picker (frontend/src/components/pastAttendance/MarkPastAttendanceSheet.tsx, Calendar with className="premium-calendar"), the header renders as: left arrow | centered month+year | right arrow, with the month text visually centered between arrows.
Header has horizontal padding of at least 16px on both sides and a bottom margin of at least 12px before the weekday row.
Weekday row (SU MO TU WE TH FR SA) is visually separated below the header and never overlaps with the arrows or month label.
Date grid is visually separated below the weekday row with clean padding/spacing; no elements overlap at any viewport width.
Month title does not shift position when navigating months; arrows stay pinned to left/right extremes.
Navigation arrow buttons have comfortable clickable/tappable area (8–12px padding equivalent) and do not collide with the weekday row.
No calendar functionality changes: date selection, disabled future dates, and month navigation behavior remain unchanged.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (immutable UI component sources must be composed, not edited).
Do not change calendar functionality (date selection, disabled dates, navigation behavior); this is a layout/spacing fix only.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not add new calendar features (e.g., range selection, week numbers, custom tooltips).
Do not change the past attendance flow logic, validation rules, or save behavior.
Do not introduce new timers/intervals or polling related to the calendar UI.
